name: gd-annual-stamp-tax
description: Grenada annual stamp tax calculation and calendar reference checked for 2026. Covers the previous-year gross-receipts base, rate selection around EC$300,000, the EC$36,000 exemption, minimum tax and numerical illustrations. Includes the ordinary return deadline, instalment description and the specific 2026 filing and payment extension. Use for Grenada business turnover stamp tax or annual stamp tax returns. This tax is distinct from property transfer duties and VAT. Eligibility, exemptions, special disaster measures, collection details and low-receipt minimum-tax interactions need statutory review. Official indexed administrative guidance is not presented as a complete legislative audit.
